name: green-harness
description: Connects Claude Code to a harness server: MCP tools, and hooks that forward tool calls to the server only in a session you attach with /green-harness:start.

server_url.title: Harness server URL
server_url.description: The server's base URL, for example https://harness.example.com (no path).

key.title: Harness key
key.description: Your tenant key from the server owner. Sent only as an Authorization header to the MCP endpoint.
